# Third-party art packs (Freehold)

## Purchased Unity Asset Store packs (primary visuals)

### Floreswa — Low Poly Character Pack

- **Publisher:** Floreswa
- **Imported to:** `Assets/Floreswa/`
- **Used for:** player visual (`Prefabs/male01_1.prefab` / `Models/male01_1.fbx`)
- **License:** Unity Asset Store EULA (purchased; do not redistribute outside the buyer’s project)

### BigRookGames — Stylized Hand Painted Nature Pack (Free)

- **Publisher:** BigRookGames
- **Imported to:** `Assets/BigRookGames/Nature Pack/`
- **Used for:** StarterArea trees, bushes/grass dressing, ground grass material
- **Note:** Pack has no dedicated rock meshes; denser bushes/borders dress rock slots
- **License:** Unity Asset Store EULA (purchased/free store download; do not redistribute outside the buyer’s project)

## Vendored CC0 fallbacks (`Assets/ThirdParty/`)

Still used for loot meshes and campfire kit pieces where the store packs have no equivalents.

### Kenney — Nature Kit

- **Source:** https://opengameart.org/content/nature-kit (also https://kenney.nl)
- **License:** CC0 1.0 — see `KenneyNatureKit/LICENSE.txt`
- **Used for:** campfire stones/logs, stick/stone pickups
- **Credit (optional):** Kenney.nl

### Quaternius — Ultimate RPG Items Pack

- **Source:** https://opengameart.org/content/low-poly-rpg-pack
- **License:** CC0 1.0 — see `QuaterniusRpgItems/LICENSE.txt`
- **Used for:** axe, dagger (knife), hammer (pickaxe stand-in), potions (bottles), chicken leg / bag (food)
- **Credit (optional):** Quaternius

### Vuena — Free Low-Poly Characters (CC0)

- **Source:** https://github.com/Vuena/free-low-poly-characters-cc0
- **License:** CC0 1.0 — see `VuenaBlockyCharacters/LICENSE`
- **Status:** retained in repo but **no longer the active player visual** (replaced by Floreswa)
